rows.comment: Short status title that says what is wrong.
Stacked clauses and "nothing is lost" is a bare reassurance. Say the mechanism: the band keeps recording.
lineComments: Wordy cause; say Bluetooth is off and no app can reach the band.
Replace the reassurance with what the band does.
rows.replacement:
'Bluetooth is off on this phone, so no app can reach the band. '
'The band keeps recording and sends the data when you reconnect.'

rows.comment: Passive and the semicolon antithesis can be two direct statements.
lineComments: Passive "can only be reached"; name the actor.
Contrast clause; state what the user can still do.
rows.replacement:
'The band connects only over Bluetooth Low Energy. You can still '
'import data, but you cannot sync live.'

rows.comment: Passive present perfect; say what the app did.
"rather than pin the radio" is jargon and an unprompted contrast. State the reason and what the user must do.
lineComments: Keeps the refusal count; interpolation must stay.
Say what the user must do.
rows.replacement:
'The band refused the pairing key $bondRefusals times in a row, so the '
'app stopped retrying to avoid draining both batteries on a link that '
'will not open. The app does not reconnect '
'until you act.'

rows.comment: Direct statement of the needed action.
Passive and "are safe" is vague; say the recordings stay on the band.
lineComments: Cause explanation is fine but wordy.
Active voice: the band drops commands.
Replace "are safe" with where they are.
rows.replacement:
'The link opens, but the band rejects the encryption key stored on the '
'phone, so it drops every command and no data moves. Your '
'recordings stay on the band.'

rows.comment: Em dash and repeated reassurance. Split into short sentences.
lineComments: Em dash; split into two sentences.
"nothing is lost" repeats the previous clause.
Say what is needed to continue.
rows.replacement:
'The band keeps re-sending the same batch because the app cannot get '
'its confirmation through. The app already saved everything in the '
'batch. The band cannot move on until the '
'confirmation arrives.'

rows.comment: Say what the band does, plainly.
rows.replacement: 'The band is not sending its recordings'

rows.comment: "still safe; it just is not" is a soft contrast. State the fact.
lineComments: "still safe" is reassurance; say they remain on the band.
rows.replacement:
'The band reports newer recordings than it will send. Those recordings '
'remain on the band, but it is not sending them '
'to the phone.'

rows.comment: "almost always" is a hedge and "a single" is flourish.
lineComments: Hedge; say "usually" and name the clock.
State what the app does on connect.
rows.replacement:
'The band completes each sync without sending any sensor readings, '
'which usually means its internal clock is wrong. The app resets '
'the clock on every connect.'

rows.comment: Concrete recovery step with a time.

rows.replacement: 'The band is connected and sending its recordings.'

lineComments: Jargon; say scanning for its Bluetooth signal.
rows.replacement: 'Scanning for a Bluetooth signal from the band.'

lineComments: Causes listed; use "charging" and "connected to another app".
rows.replacement:
'The band is out of range, charging, or connected to another app. '
'It keeps recording.'

rows.comment: Developer error message for a byte-length check, not shown to users.
Developer error message naming an internal class.
Wordy, em dash, and "expect to restart" hedges. This is a needed warning, so keep the cause and the fix and state them directly.
lineComments: Describes the cause in a roundabout way.
Em dash; split into a new sentence.
Say what to do and what happens otherwise.
rows.replacement:
'Your main band is not paired yet. Searching for a sensor now starts '
'Bluetooth in a way that hides the system pairing sheet until you '
'restart the app. Pair your main band first, or restart '
'the app before you pair it.'

rows.comment: Hedged double "may"; list the two causes directly.
rows.replacement:
'That sensor did not answer. It may be asleep or connected to '
'another phone or app.'

rows.comment: Good error content (missing UUIDs, nothing saved). Tighten wording and keep interpolations.
rows.replacement:
'That device answered but does not expose the '
'${entry.label} data this needs '
'(missing ${missing.map((u) => u.substring(0, 8)).join(", ")}). '
'Nothing was saved.'

rows.comment: Says what happened and that nothing was saved.
"before it could be set up" is passive; shorten.
rows.replacement:
'That sensor disconnected during setup. Nothing was '
'saved.'
